sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Museums after the virtual tour
passage.text: When museums closed their doors, they put their collections online. Virtual tours attracted millions of visitors, and many institutions assumed they had found a new audience. The data tell a subtler story. Online visitors spend minutes, not hours, and rarely return; they behave like people browsing a shop window rather than like visitors. What the digital version does well is preparation and follow-up: a teacher can show a class a painting before a visit, and a visitor can look again at an object that caught the eye. Museums that treat the website as a substitute for the gallery are disappointed; those that treat it as a doorway are not.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: Museums that treat the website as a substitute for the gallery are disappointed; those that treat it as a doorway are not.

answer.text: 把网站当作展厅替代品的博物馆会失望；而把它当作入口的博物馆则不会。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: museums now offer virtual tours of their collections. Some believe this makes physical visits unnecessary. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

answer.text: Virtual tours have opened museum collections to anyone with a screen, and some commentators conclude that physical visits are becoming unnecessary. The evidence suggests otherwise. Online visitors stay for minutes and rarely return, treating the collection as a shop window rather than an experience. What the digital version does best is prepare and extend a visit: a class can study a painting before arriving, and a visitor can return to an object that caught the eye. A substitute competes with the gallery; a doorway leads into it. Museums should therefore design their websites as doorways, using high-quality images and clear context to make the physical visit more likely, not less.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只谈「线上方便」或「线下不可替代」，没有指出两者是互补关系。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞

walkthrough.approach: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
